messages:
Nate H: Quick sync  Partner Gamma wants a multi-region A/B with phased fallbacks. They insist on daily eval hooks and legal approval for samples. Need compact plan + owners.
Rachael B: Proposed approach: micro A/B 10k sample test during 5% EU slice, then 25% EU ramp if metrics stable. Keep NA shadowing. Block promos during windows.
Devon P: Tech constraints: use `g_gamma.eu.smallctx` pinned variant. Pre-warm EU pool 20m before canary. Reserve +30% burst for first 4h.
SRE-ops: Rollback/gates: auto-rollback if 5xx >0.9% for 3m OR p95 latency +25% over baseline for 5m. For quality degrade: if A/B ranking delta >4% -> pause ramp and run failover to regional fallback `g_gamma.global.safe`. Manual kill-switch must flip in <20s.
CS-Liz: Partner Gamma requests: daily eval webhook (first 5 days), per-tenant latency histogram, and up to 100 sanitized payloads/day for 72h. They want a signed appendix for telemetry and retention windows.
Legal: We'll need DPA addendum. Samples allowed 7d retention max; aggregates 90d. PII must be stripped/masked before delivery.
Devon P: Flag naming: `gamma.partner.eu.ab.v1`. Suggested Console canary JSON:
```
{"flag":"gamma.partner.eu.ab.v1","canary":[{"slice":"rand-5pct","duration":"3h","ab_test":{"enabled":true,"sample_size":10000}},{"slice":"eu-25pct","duration":"24h"}],"fallback":"g_gamma.global.safe","prewarm":true}
```
Rachael B: Add quality gate: if daily eval shows >3% regression on partner gold set we stop and require Product+CS review. Also include a soft rollforward option: swap to `g_gamma.eu.alt` (less aggressive quant) if regression between 3-6%.
SRE-ops: We'll implement soft rollforward automation: disable failing slices -> enable alt variant -> run fast-eval on 1k prompts -> if pass, continue; else full rollback. Ops will test kill-switch and rollforward in staging.
Nate H: Owners recap: Product -> telemetry appendix + partner signoff; Eng-Platform -> flag, prewarm, webhook; SRE -> SLOs, rollforward/rollback automation; Legal -> DPA; CS -> evaluation coordination.

CS-Liz: Partner also asked for latency heatmap at T+6h and T+24h and token-cost delta. Can Eng-Platform commit?
Devon P: Yes, we'll deliver heatmaps + token-cost delta csvs.
Nate H: Cutover window: Thursday 09:00 UTC pending signoffs. Please ack by Tuesday EOD. :thumbsup:
